_why: ui.statamic-cms-package expects a package.json to mean a Control Panel Vite build, and asks for
@statamic/cms in devDependencies so the UI kit is pinned to the Statamic version in vendor/.
This addon adds no Control Panel surface at all. Its only CP presence is a global set, which is
core's own screen behind a published blueprint, and it imports nothing from @statamic/cms/ui.
The package.json here exists for one reason: playwright-core, which drives the browser checks
for the three behaviours that live only in the browser (the localStorage mirror, Global Privacy
Control, parked scripts). Adding the dependency would pull a UI kit nothing imports.
Revisit this the day the addon grows a real CP screen — then the rule is right and this entry
release.editions is an INFO, not a rule, and it asks a question rather than reporting a fault:
"Confirm this is a single-edition commercial addon." Confirmed on 2026-08-24 — $20, one
product, no Core/Pro split. See MARKETPLACE.md. The field stays absent because the linter is
right that a declared edition without a feature behind it cannot gate anything.
